plugins.name: gradle-skills
plugins.description: Skills for working with Gradle projects.

plugins.name: roadmap-skills
plugins.description: Skills for driving a repo's roadmap: claim the next item and build it, for repos you own or upstream OSS projects you contribute to via a fork.

plugins.name: session-skills
plugins.description: Puts a unit of work on its own branch and gets it back off again: pick up the branch work is already in flight on or open a new one, and land the work by what the repo is rather than by a declared mode.

plugins.name: parallel-session-skills
plugins.description: Keeps several sessions working one repo at once off each other's files: open a git worktree for each, claim a lane in a shared ledger before writing code, reap dead claims without killing a live sibling, and conduct 2-5 lanes at once when a run has nobody watching it.

plugins.name: writing-conventions
plugins.description: Always-on rules for plain prose without AI tells—in chat, in repo docs, and in anything published under your name—with a lint that reports each miss in the next turn.

plugins.name: ghostwriting-skills
plugins.description: Drafts text that ships under your name—issues, PRs, comments, commit messages, docs—in your voice, from a spec derived from your writing, and keeps that spec current from your edits.

plugins.name: orchestration-skills
plugins.description: Rules for handing work to other agents without losing control of it: what is worth delegating, what every brief must include, which agents worktree isolation breaks, which tier each stage runs at, how to tell a finished stage from one that merely stopped talking, and when to stop and ask the user instead of deciding alone.

plugins.name: confer
plugins.description: Claude and Codex challenge each other's analysis, requirements, designs, code reviews, and answers to a question until they agree.
